pages.text: When chat says a $(bold)Gate$() has opened, take the coordinates and go. Ranks run E, D, C, B, A, S. Start with E and D.$(br2)Clear the boss before the timer ends. Fail and the monsters break out into the Overworld.$(br2)You return to the spot you entered from. Kills inside Gates count for the leaderboard.

Inside Solo Leveling dungeons some passages are sealed with a $(bold)padlock block$(). Hold the matching key (yellow, blue or red) and right-click the lock to open it. Keys come from the System's reward boxes. Keep every key you get.
